text: Albuquerque, 2017. Officer Ryan Holets found a homeless woman behind a store, *pregnant and using heroin.* On his body camera, he told her she was going to hurt her baby. She cried and said she wished someone would adopt it. Then he made an offer: *he and his wife would adopt the baby.* Three weeks later, a baby girl was born. They named her *Hope.* Hit like for the good ones.
title: The Officer Who Said I'll Take Her 👮❤️
